title: Six For The Goal One For The Behind (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle aussie outback
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, Aussie Rules is not rugby
Four posts, two sticks, oval ball, oval ground
Six for the goal, one for the behind

[Verse 1]
Four posts standing tall at each end
Two big sticks in the middle, the major bend
Two little sticks on the outside flanks
Thats the goal mouth, son, the Aussie ranks

[Pre-Chorus]
Kick the ball through the two big sticks clean
No touch on the way, the goal supreme
Six points on the board, the goal umpire signals
Two white flags waved, the crowd erupts in finals

[Chorus]
Six for the goal one for the behind, son
Four posts, two umpires, the work begun
Through the big sticks clean, six points
Touched or through the smaller posts, one anoints

[Verse 2]
If the ball is touched on the way through, one point
If it goes between big stick and little stick, one point
If the defender knocks it through their own posts, one point
The behind is the miss with a reward, the joint

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, this is what makes the game brilliant
Missing the goal still gets a point, resilient
No zero reward for trying, son
A close shave still counts, the game is fun

[Chorus]
Six for the goal one for the behind, son
Four posts, two umpires, the work begun
Through the big sticks clean, six points
Touched or through the smaller posts, one anoints

[Outro]
Six for goal, one for behind
Two flags or one, the umpire signed
Four posts, oval ground
Thats my boy, the Aussie sound
